name: io.github.nazar256/memheaven
title: MemHeaven — Self-hosted Remote MCP Memory for ChatGPT
description: Self-hosted remote MCP memory server for ChatGPT and AI agents.

worker_domain.description: Public MemHeaven hostname, for example memheaven.<your-workers-subdomain>.workers.dev or memory.example.com

auth.notes: Hosted OAuth flow with PKCE and dynamic client registration where supported, plus an access-key gate on the consent page.

setupNotes: Deploy on Cloudflare Workers, then point the client at https://<your-worker-domain>/mcp.
Generate an access key with npm run keygen and authorize with the printed raw key.
See docs/GETTING_STARTED_FROM_ZERO.md for a full guided setup.
